jobs.description:

Your Responsibilities:

- Analyze, evaluate, and technically approve jigs, tools, and manufacturing aids.
- Act as the technical interface to suppliers within project activities and support supplier management.
- Prepare specifications for the procurement of jigs, tools, and other manufacturing equipment.
- Support the selection of technical project suppliers based on defined criteria and technical requirements.
- Create, review, and validate engineering and manufacturing datasets.
- Work closely with the Quality Department on acceptance tracking and handover activities.
- Design using 3DX and CATIA, while coordinating closely with manufacturing and production teams.
- Consolidate technical requirements related to process analysis and manufacturing optimization and contribute to the continuous improvement of production processes.

- Completed degree in Engineering or a comparable technical qualification with practical experience in design, manufacturing, or production.

- Experience in supplier management, supplier coordination, and technical collaboration with external partners.
- Practical experience in project management, requirements management, and structured design planning.
- Strong understanding of process analysis, manufacturing optimization, and the implementation of technical solutions.
- Very good German and English language skills.
- Full-time position with a 35-hour work week.
- Willingness to undertake occasional business travel (approximately two to three trips per year).
- Strong organizational skills, high self-motivation, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under time pressure.
- Initial experience with Click'n Buy and Google Workspace is considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Senior Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE) - Cabin & Safety (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global leader in engineering, IT, and R&D services. Through our comprehensive 360° offering, we help clients navigate an increasingly dynamic technological and competitive landscape and shape a sustainable, smart future. Our 50,000 visionary experts worldwide drive innovation with creativity, expertise, and dedication, creating a smarter world for tomorrow.

We are looking for experienced Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) with strong expertise in Cabin & Safety certification to support aircraft interior modification and certification programs.

You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements related to cabin safety systems, interior installations, and passenger accommodation products.

Apply now and help shape the next generation of aircraft interiors and passenger experiences. ✈️

- Perform compliance verification activities for cabin and safety-related systems

- Ensure compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements

- Review TSO/ETSO qualification documentation
- Define certification strategies and means of compliance
- Support authority and customer audits

Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
- Previous experience as a CVE or Senior Certification Engineer
- Strong knowledge of:
- Cabin Safety Certification
- TSO / ETSO requirements
- EASA CS-25
- FAA Part 25
- Experience working with aircraft seat suppliers
- Strong understanding of aircraft cabin systems
- Fluent English

Job Offer

- Opportunity to work partly from home and/or remotely, benefiting from the advantages of a hybrid working model (flexible working)
- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- Wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team-building and sports events
- Global network

Tesla is seeking a talented Senior Account Manager to join our growing EMEA Megapack sales team.
